description: Per-entity-type list of source identifiers to query when an investigation is queued. The investigation worker consumes this map via core/research/source_routing.py:sources_for_entity(entity_type). Order matters — sources are queried in list order and the worker may early-out on rate-limit failures; put the highest-yield sources first. Minor 1.2.0 (Jun 4 2026): adds `_source_scope` jurisdiction tagging. Sources tagged 'US' (sec_edgar, fec, sunbiz_fl, etc.) are excluded when the target entity's jurisdiction is known and is not US. Sources tagged 'GLOBAL' always run. Entity jurisdiction is read from envelope.iso_country_code, envelope.jurisdiction, or envelope.country.
_routing_principles: Person research = encyclopedic (Wikipedia/Wikidata) + sanctions (OpenSanctions/OFAC/UN) + court records (CourtListener) + politician-specific (FEC/Congress) + corporate-officer overlap (OpenCorporates). Skips org-only sources like SEC EDGAR which only surface a person if they happen to be on a Form 4 board filing — that linkage already comes from the org's investigation discovering them.

Organization research = encyclopedic + corporate filings (SEC) + government contracts (USAspending/SAM) + nonprofit (ProPublica) + sector-specific regulators (FDIC banks, FDA pharma, EPA environmental) + global registry (OpenCorporates) + regulatory mentions (Federal Register) + ownership/registration lookups (FAA aircraft). FEC committee search included because PACs are organizations.
Government agency research = encyclopedic + congressional/budget context (Congress.gov, USAspending) + regulatory output (Federal Register issuing agency).

Country research = encyclopedic + Factbook profile + REST Countries baseline + World Bank indicators + GeoNames alt-names/coords. Heavy substrate so the dossier has real depth instead of just a Wikipedia paragraph.
City / admin_region research = encyclopedic + GeoNames + Nominatim. GeoNames pulls alt-names so future Tehran/TEHRAN-style admit collisions resolve via aliases.
Aircraft research = FAA registry (only fires when entity name looks like an N-number tail). Future: IMO database for vessels, NHTSA vPIC for vehicles.
